dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: The Gardemeks are like huge clockwork toys! I wonder if I could open one up and have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: Yes. My father's a great scientist at the Fontaine Research Institute, and he brings me lots of fun toys!

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: I love opening them up from the inside out and putting them back together bit by bit.

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: Well, that later bit doesn't work out sometimes, but other times, I can pull it off without a hitch!

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: *sigh* You're not gonna make some story up to scare me off, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: "Oh, you can't touch this, or the Gardes will catch you!"

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: Adults are so boring. That blonde guy I met at Leschots's is way cooler.

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: He doesn't say much, but he lets me open his clockwork penguins up.

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: That penguin was super cute, and its internals were really interesting as well. I think he made it himself, actually! Oh, I'm so envious of him!

dialogues.speaker: Lovi
dialogues.text: Hmm... When will I own a clockwork toy of this kind?
